chunks: God has created the heavens and the earth with reason. Surely in this is a sign for those who believe.

key_terms.بِالْحَقِّ: with truth / with reason / with purpose

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God created the heavens and earth 'with truth' (al-haqq)?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'al-haqq' (truth/reality) is interpreted not merely as factual existence but as creation for a profound purpose, reflecting the divine attribute of Truthfulness. This verse serves as a foundational argument for Tawhid (monotheism), where the orderly cosmos acts as a clear sign (ayah) inviting believers to reflect on the unity and wisdom of the Creator.
